acceptance.decision_rationale: Four accepted wakes preserved the exact task ID, prompt digest, and schedule digest while provider runtime metadata advanced. The provider exposed no model build, worker instance, conversation identity, or Project context, so the controlled factor cannot distinguish carrier changes from stable scheduling. Preserve the task-contract fingerprint as a control, but reseat the next campaign variable rather than manufacture carrier-variance evidence.
acceptance.next_wake_requirement: If accepted, run C7 wake 1/4 from CURRENT v24. Vary exactly one event-canonicalization rule, retain the same version/idempotency gates, recompute exact bytes and digest, and do not change the source event after commit.
acceptance.pointer_gate: event-first exact readback; second CURRENT read; require version 23 and exact blob b25adfe19e7822b562b9d657c2d64e4e5f0fe826; single-file SHA-guarded update; returned-blob and branch-path readback
acceptance.slack_post_rule: Post one sanitized v24 campaign-decision pointer only after CURRENT advances.

experiment.baseline: CURRENT v23 at blob b25adfe19e7822b562b9d657c2d64e4e5f0fe826; C6 carrier_variance 3/4; prior event digest 32469be554ef09dfd18dc8b4bfd6dc7af6884921bfb18ab97bb8af5b0f0933d4.
experiment.controlled_factor: carrier variance, observed only through provider-exposed native task contract and task-record runtime metadata; all object transition rules held constant

wake4_native_task_read.title: HFO X12 Durable Object PDCA Lab

experiment.hypothesis: Across four wakes, the task contract fingerprint and exact task binding should remain stable even if the underlying carrier instance changes. Provider runtime timestamps may advance, but they do not identify the carrier.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: A provider-exposed carrier identifier changes across otherwise identical wakes; the prompt or schedule digest changes without authorized task mutation; provider runtime timestamps fail to advance across a completed wake; a duplicate idempotency key is accepted; a stale expected version advances; or event/CURRENT readback fails.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: The fourth observation reads provider bookkeeping for the prior completed wake, not an identity-bearing record for the carrier executing this transition. Stable task-contract hashes do not prove a stable carrier, and opaque carrier fields prevent estimating variance. RESEAT_VARIABLE means the factor was not measurable on this surface, not that carrier variance is absent. The event and CURRENT pointer are separate Git commits, and Slack follows both; GitHub's single-file blob-SHA guard does not provide cross-file atomicity, locks, linearizability, exactly-once execution, serializable transactions, database durability, Slack atomicity, or automatic orphan-event repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If later invalidated, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only using that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA.
